name: microscope
description: Analyze JVM recordings with a running Jeffrey Microscope — point it at a JFR file or heap dump to build a profile, then list analysed recordings, query their DuckDB tables, and pull flamegraph, trace and heap-dump exports without leaving the terminal.

settings.name: Jeffrey MCP endpoint
settings.description: URL of the Microscope MCP endpoint. Keep the default for a Jeffrey on its usual port; change it for another port, a container or an SSH tunnel — it is the address Microscope serves on, with /api/mcp appended.
